say:0:1631226001:0.text: The roar is deafening, yet oddly calming.
say:0:1631226001:0.source_cn: ……瀑布的声浪震耳，却让人莫名心静。
say:0:1631226001:0.male: The roar is deafening, yet oddly calming.
say:0:1631226001:0.female: The roar is deafening, yet oddly calming.

say:1:1631226002:0.text: No wonder the ancients trained their minds beneath waterfalls.
say:1:1631226002:0.source_cn: 难怪古人会选择在瀑布下磨炼意志。
say:1:1631226002:0.male: No wonder the ancients trained their minds beneath waterfalls.
say:1:1631226002:0.female: No wonder the ancients trained their minds beneath waterfalls.

say:0:1631227001:0.text: The thunder of water washes stray thoughts away...
say:0:1631227001:0.male: The thunder of water washes stray thoughts away...
say:0:1631227001:0.female: The thunder of water washes stray thoughts away...
